name: il-rulespec-2026-09-29
description: Israel tax-benefit pilot, contributions increment, for supervised RuleSpec-IL encoding of an employee's two payroll deductions: every section- and schedule-level provision that the captured he.wikisource.org OpenLaw pages render for four instruments. Three are the 2026-09-06 pilot captures, byte-identical to release il-rulespec-2026-09-06 (same files, same sha256; every row's body, heading, labels, dates and metadata unchanged, only the version-bound ids and snapshot paths differ): the Income Tax Ordinance [New Version] (Knesset IsraelLawID 2000944), the National Insurance Law [Consolidated Version] 5755-1995 (2000198), and the Economic Efficiency Law (Legislative Amendments for Achieving the Budget Targets for the 2026 Budget Year) 5786-2026 (2242332). For those three, release il-rulespec-2026-09-06's per-instrument statements carry over unchanged: the Ordinance's hash-pinned supplement for sections 235-247 and its four schedules, the seven amending-act sections that OpenLaw keeps only inside the instruments they amend, mixed numbers that keep the page's boundary, table cells that keep their columns, and the ITO section 187 transcription defect carried through unrepaired. The fourth instrument is new: the National Health Insurance Law 5754-1994 (2000111), captured in the same 2026-09-06 session (page revision 3073760), whose section 14 sets the employee's health-insurance rates (5.17% in 14(b)(1), and 3.23% in 14(f1) on the part of income not above the reduced amount fixed under National Insurance Law section 341). Its second schedule is divided into parts whose items restart at 1, so those items sit under their part (schedule-2/sign-1/item-1, schedule-2/sign-2/item-1); its section 1 follows the table of contents directly; and its sections 62 to 66 amend four other laws and one set of emergency regulations and keep no text of their own, because OpenLaw prints it inside the enactments they amend (metadata.text_merged_into). Checked 2026-09-29: the page's one later revision (3081417, 2026-09-09) only deletes eight '(from 17.8.2026)' commencement notes in the second schedule, at part 1 item 28 and part 2 item 3, which this capture therefore still prints; section 14 is unchanged. That is a reconciliation of a capture, not the complete statute as administered: 1,633 rows against 1,633 source-inventory entries, 0 missing and 0 extra. Release validation reports ten empty_provision_text warnings: the five merged amending-act sections that also lack a heading, and health-law sections 62 to 66. The provision text is an OpenLaw consolidation, not an official gazette text; the Ordinance is consolidation-knesset-linked and the other three instruments consolidation-wikisource, and every row carries its own tier. It carries statute text only: no regulations and no Tax Authority or National Insurance Institute amount publications, so the reduced collection bracket and the basic amount for a given year remain outside it.
